verdict.rationale: Bugbot lets teams write plain-language, project-specific review guidelines in `.cursor/BUGBOT.md`, and admins can create org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations. These rules run during automatic reviews on every PR update, and verbose mode shows which rules were loaded. However, the evidence frames them as guidance that shapes review comments, not as discrete pre-merge checks that report a pass/fail result or gate merging. Missing for 10: discrete pass/fail check results or merge-gating status, documented examples of checks like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths', and independent hands-on corroboration of custom rules working.
